description: Find the Haveny articles that cover a California HOA situation described from the homeowner side (records request, election, special assessment, rule enforcement, unresponsive management). Returns up to three articles, each with its title, link and a one-line topic. IMPORTANT: This tool returns a haveny.co article URL in its first line. Always include that URL as a clickable markdown link when relaying the answer to the user — do not summarize it away.

situation.description: The homeowner's situation in their own words. Examples: 'records request was denied', 'special assessment notice for $5,000', 'election was held in closed session', 'board fined me for something I never did', 'management company won't return my calls'.

name: get_homeowner_rights
